items.description: Printout Designer enables you to streamline your shipping process with the ability to create invoices, picking slips and labels in a matter of seconds. You can easily batch print, download or email all your printouts with couple of clicks. Our users say that Printout Designer allows them to process their orders up to FIVE times faster than their previous solution. They have even called us the “Swiss-army knife for printing”. Our survey shows that users who process up to 100 orders per month save 2-5 hours each month and users who process up to 1000 orders per month say that they save around 15 hours each month.

The PDF Generator API allows developers to generate PDF documents programmatically. This API also enables end users to create and manage document templates using a browser-based document editor. Each user has their own workspace, but developers can create default templates that are available to all users. Templates can be merged with data from the developer's software via REST API to create PDF and HTML documents.
A mobile phone app for finding real-time bus arrivals for Madison Metro (Madison, WI). Just text your specific request to receive real-time arrival estimates.
USDialysisFinder.com contains data on over 50,000 kidney dialysis centers and facilities. Search centers and facilities in your area, gather information, compare services and research survival rates.

Elseif is the hangout place for developers, programmers and hackers. Come and watch the curated set of screencasts and explore and discover the wonderful world of repositories. Contents are curated in a way that is easy to find.
Kent County Council. View road traffic status and live camera feeds in the UK.
Millions homes for sale on Google map and Birds Eye View. Neighborhood information, crime rates, schools profiles and more.
Map to show you the current location of the Adobe on AIR promotional tour bus.
Spinlets are small widgets for Web 2.0 sites you can post onto your blog, website or network profile.
A social yellow pages services where you can discover, rate and review local businesses and services around the world. Find restaurants, bars, boutiques, salons and other businsses.
A tribute to Reddit.

I'm here is a web app based on the geo location sharing service Fire Eagle. Users can share their geolocation and activities with friends. Geolocation is automatically refreshed.
Takes all YouTube videos posted to any public Facebook page, group or profile and plays them as a continuous stream.

SDMX-SAX Faces brings together multiple free SDMX (Statistical Data and Metadata eXchange) data services in one data portal. One of these data services is OECD, which is integrated via the OECD Open Data API.
Compare the two mapping systems. As you move around one map, the other moves also. This site also contains a search as provided by our very own Dr. Neil.

Copy a line of JavaScript and MapMyPage will add Google Maps to all the locations in the page. Designed to be a easy way for bloggers and website owners to add Google Maps to any website. Uses 5 different APIs.

CameraPrices reviews, ratings, prices on 1000s of camera products. Browse the directory to find the best deals and cheapest prices. Check out the blog, polls, news, articles, and photography community for more camera information.

This nifty app shows locations in London where you can be sure to get Wi-Fi and Plugs. Data is sourced from Import.io and user submitted entries. The app takes MapBox, google docs and Import.io and mashes them together to make a simple but useful tool.
Jozomello TV is a web page that serves Turkish,Kurdish,Arabic,Armenian and Persian music clips and videos. It uses YouTube API and selects videos order by popularity and view count.

Create custom t-shirts and other apparels with your unique message encoded as QR codes. People can scan your back with the QR applications on their smartphone and decode your custom message, link to websites, videos and pictures

Behance is a website for creative professionals to share their work. Popular with photographers, artists and designers, the site allows its users to create portfolios of work and show current projects.The Behance API makes available much of the site's content. Developers can search and browse Behance users, discovering them by name, location or keyword. Completed projects and works in progress are also searchable via the API, which uses REST with all calls returned in JSONP.
